answer: Referral-graph escrow blocks fakes. Each identity takes one orchard plot, locks 70 credits, posts an onyx seal. Sponsors vouch for at most two per epoch; a gale auditor replays the public log when peers dispute a plot; cheating burns the bond and slashes the sponsor. Seals cost 45 each: 1,000 fakes pay 45,000, lock 70,000, rent 500 slots for 125,000, against a 40,000 pool. Rented referrers pay per head. Honest agents pay 45 once, keep the bond.
